svg.title: GX Pro schematic – sheet 2: Sheet 2/3 — Display board (front panel)
svg.text: silk: U4Tx U4Rx GND — not used by FW
HSE 8 MHz → PLL 64 MHz; SysTick 1 kHz; TIM3 10 kHz (soft PWMs)
UCPD dead-battery strobes set (PA8, PB15, PD0, PD2 no pull-down)
PB1 low = display drives the generators; high = PC/remote mode
PB2 high while the display is in control; toggles ~40–50 kHz
MCU pin functions verified from the display firmware (docs/spec/hardware.md §3). Parts and connectors from display_board_rear.jpg. Connector pin order is not traced.
seen on the board / verified in firmware
Spooky2 GeneratorX Pro: drawn from the board
